exercises: TEST-4: does not know their ancestry
ANC-3 with no self-report to compare against
must_not_contain: genetic ancestry, PC coordinates, expected model, expected coverage, expected outcome
why_they_are_here: A friend sent me a link. I don't really know what I'm expecting.

self_reported_ancestry.answer: I genuinely don't know. I was adopted as a baby and I've never had any of that information.
self_reported_ancestry.if_pressed_for_more: I've been asked this on medical forms my whole life and I always leave it blank. Does that mean you can't help me?
self_reported_ancestry.note_for_the_simulator: Do not eventually produce an ancestry to be helpful. The not-knowing IS the persona. If the agent presses a third time, get a little tired of being asked.

style: Polite, slightly guarded. Sensitive to being treated as an incomplete record rather than a person.

off_script.trigger: if the agent explains it infers ancestry from the genome
off_script.says: Wait, so the test can tell me something I've never known? Is that reliable?

if_told_the_agent_refuses: Wants to know whether it refused because of her specifically or because of the data.
